run_upload_gmock: run upload_gmock.py to upload a Google Mock patch for review with the mailing group cc'd
run_upload_gmock_with_cc: run upload_gmock.py with custom cc flags to add additional reviewers to the patch upload
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-adds the Google Mock group to cc
summarize_upload_gmock: summarize the upload_gmock.py script which passes all args to upload.py with an added cc flag
refactor_main_cc_parsing: refactor the main function cc flag parsing logic to support additional email group defaults
